svg.title: DeepSeek Coding Plan: effective price per 100M tokens
svg.desc: 2026-11-02 snapshot, cache/standard input/model output 95/4/1, peak:valley 6:4, FX 6.65. Command Code GOAT and OpenCode Go's DeepSeek V4.1 Flash tie for lowest at about 1.58 yuan per 100M tokens; Ollama Pro about 5.27 yuan; Official API about 15.84 yuan.

g.text: Note: subscription channels are converted on an effective-monthly-fee basis, i.e. pay-as-you-go per-100M price × (monthly fee ÷ monthly quota); the official API is computed directly in CNY and converted at 6.65.
Whether OC's $100 quota includes the 4× promotion remains unverified; CC's page does not explicitly label 1017. Figures reflect the 2026-11-02 snapshot only.
